m: मशक m. a mosquito, gnat, any fly that bites or stings, AV. &c. &c.
a partic. skin disease (causing dark bean-like pustules or eruptions), VarBṛS.; Suśr.
a leather water-bag, KātyŚr.
N. of a preceptor with the patr. Gārgya (the composer of a Kalpa-sūtra), Lāṭy. (IW. 176)
N. of the district in Śāka-dvīpa inhabited by Kṣatriyas, MBh.
a: मशकः — [मश्-वुन्] 1 A mosquito, gnat; सर्वं खलस्य चरितं मशकः करोति H. 1. 81; Ms. 1. 85. --2 A particular disease of the skin. --3 A leather water-bag. --4 N. of a district in Śākadvīpa inhabited by Kṣatriyas. --Comp. --कुटिः --टी f., --वरणं a whisk for scaring away mosquitos. --हरी a mosquito-curtain.

मशक—कल्प m. N. of wk.

मशकोदुम्बर m. du. or n. sg. a m˚ and a fig-tree (often combined as connected with each other and yet very different), MBh. (cf. next).
मशन n. a sound, L.
मशर्शार m. N. of a man, RV. i, 122, 15.
